These support Palula bīyī with weakened medial affricate provisionally, western bidz/vidz/βij/βidz and Dungra uije with reduced initial labial. These support βidzaḷi/vižəḷi/vidzḷi/bidzali/bijale/bidzale and provisionally ijiḷi with initial loss. Preserve lateral quality and final vowels; local changes and cross-IA transmission are qualified.
